{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
# No QA orders found (0 rows), but we'll filter anyway for robustness
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = filtered_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Sort by revenue to find the highest
channel_revenue_sorted = channel_revenue.sort_values('revenue_clean', ascending=False)

# Print results
print(channel_revenue_sorted)
print(f"\nTotal number of valid orders (completed, not QA): {filtered_df.shape[0]}")"}
